Third-party libraries, vendored so the app works offline. d3 and graphology are loaded on demand by `js/graph.js` for the Connections map. marked renders SPEC.md on the docs site (`docs/spec.html`).

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| d3.min.js | d3 | 7.9.0 | ISC |
| graphology.umd.min.js | graphology | 0.25.4 | MIT |
| graphology-library.min.js | graphology-library | 0.8.0 | MIT |
| marked.min.js | marked | 15.0.12 | MIT |

Fetched from cdnjs (d3) and jsDelivr (graphology, marked). To update, download the same files at the new version.
